newsitem.title: USA: Med-Design knows no reason for stock action.
newsitem.headline: Med-Design knows no reason for stock action.

text.p: Med-Design Corp said Friday it is unaware of any reason its stock, which recently has traded down sharply, should be under pressure.

"We know of no recent material adverse developments concerning our business or financial affairs that would account for the weakness in the stock price," Chairman and Chief Executive James Donegan said in a statement.
In Friday afternoon trading, Med-Design's stock was down 7/16ths to five, a 52-week low. Its 52-week high is 16-1/4.
Med-Design makes retractable safety needle products.
